body.name: optimizer strict-gain certificate
body.construction: For every budget \(\gamma\), use the tangent cone \(T_u\), the subdifferential \(\partial\Psi_{\alpha,\gamma}(u)\), and the normal cone \(N_{\Delta(\mathcal B)}(u)\) to decide whether \(u\) solves the average-design program. The no-borrow set is \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{cc}}\), and \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{cc}}\) is the first budget after which every larger budget belongs to that set.
